items.text: Chargers listing WR Ladd McConkey as questionable for Sunday vs Raiders due to rib injury; did practice Friday.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1 hit; DNP Wed/Thu, practiced Friday; team signed MVS as depth.
items.implication: Game-time decision; if out, major boost to secondary WRs; monitor for ACTIVE.
items.opportunity: Clear WR1 routes/targets when healthy; Week 1 partial still led team.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs Saints after hamstring injury; missed multiple practices.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 1 (5/150/1 in half); DNP Wed/Thu, limited return Friday but doubtful designation.
items.implication: Likely sit; monitor active/inactive closely; hierarchy shifts if out.
items.opportunity: Primary target earner; red-zone/two-minute upside now open.

items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful for Sunday vs Chargers due to knee (meniscus) injury, per HC Klint Kubiak.
items.why: Still recovering from preseason meniscus trim; limited/no full practices early week, returned Friday but doubtful.
items.implication: Expect sit Week 2; Michael Mayer elevated as TE1 option.
items.opportunity: High route/target share expected when healthy; Mayer led targets Week 1.

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow as questionable for Sunday at Houston due to back injury; Burrow said he would play.
items.why: Back soreness; limited practices midweek but self-reported will play.
items.implication: Likely plays but monitor; CIN pass game (Chase/Higgins) volume tied to status.
items.opportunity: High-volume QB when healthy; matchup vs HOU secondary.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go'; unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but returning at right time. Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown IR; nice upcoming matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF etc) before bye.
items.why: Ankle recovery complete; full practice; Brown absence creates playmaker need.
items.implication: Handcuff/stash with upside; potential role expansion in committee.
items.opportunity: Explosive upside; Stevenson pass-down primary but schedule/matchups favor share growth.
items.conflict: Unclear exact snap/carry split vs Stevenson.

items.text: If Zay Flowers (hamstring) can't go, Ravens WRs hierarchy: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester 4. Elijah Sarratt 5. Chris Moore. Ja'Kobi Lane already on IR/return (wrist).
items.why: Flowers DNP second straight practice; Lane IR opens room further.
items.implication: Bateman primary beneficiary for targets/routes if Flowers OUT; waiver priority.
items.opportunity: Flowers primary; Bateman next in pecking order for snaps/routes/targets.

items.text: Nico Collins hamstring in Wed practice (history of missing 5 games 2024); Week 1 routes on 42 Stroud dropbacks: Collins 37, Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27, Noel 15. MRI critical.
items.why: High route share + hammy history; now confirmed OUT.
items.implication: Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel/Schultz see route/target spike; chase on waivers.
items.opportunity: 37/42 routes Week 1 signals massive opportunity share available.

items.text: Week 2 waiver injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre’ Harris; Ja’Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs etc. Precise role/usage focus.
items.why: Direct injury fallout mapping for available players with snap/route upside.
items.implication: Priority adds for handcuffs/backups with expanded opportunity.
items.opportunity: Route/target/carry shares opening via absences (McConkey ribs, Lane IR, Kamara return but Miller share).

items.text: Important: We have a “My Guy” narrative brewing in Baltimore (context of Flowers/Lane absences elevating others like Bateman).
items.why: Injury-driven hierarchy shift creating breakout narrative for secondary Raven WRs.
items.implication: Monitor/start beneficiaries if Flowers inactive; speculative upside.
items.opportunity: Expanded routes/targets in BAL offense without Flowers/Lane.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% target rate on routes Week 1; IND just gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite utilization + soft run matchup; #1 RB range of outcomes possible.
items.opportunity: 74% snaps, high target share, goal-line work.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty (@LAC: 99 util score, 19% tgt share recent) and Bucky Irving (vs CLE: every RZ RB touch, 26% tgt, out-routed Gainwell; CLE soft vs run).
items.why: Elite utilization metrics Week 1 + favorable matchups/scripts.
items.implication: Strong starts; volume floors with upside.
items.opportunity: Jeanty near-100 util/touches; Irving full RZ + routes.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson (@CHI w/ Wentz 37% tgt, career avg strong), DeVonta Smith (@TEN 27% tgt/deep looks), Mike Evans (vs MIA soft corners, 25% RZ), Dalton Kincaid (vs DET high routes/util), Dak Prescott (vs WAS high total/home).
items.why: Target/route shares + matchup edges (soft secondaries, high totals).
items.implication: Start with confidence; volume + efficiency spots.
items.opportunity: High tgt shares, RZ looks, route rates elevated.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne (@BAL: split carries, air-dependent, Kamara return squeezes), Marvin Harrison Jr. (vs SEA: 8% tgt share Week 1), Brian Thomas Jr. (@DEN tough perimeter D + shoulder), Harold Fannin (@TB low tgt/aDOT).
items.why: Poor utilization, tough matchups, or role compression.
items.implication: Fade/sit; look elsewhere for safer volume.
items.opportunity: Etienne split + Kamara; MHJ low share; BTJ limited + D; Fannin low aDOT/tgt.
